zh.1: <color=#ffffff>[强化特殊技：敬请安息]</color>命中时，使敌方全属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；自身暴击伤害提升40%。
zh.2: <color=#ffffff>[强化特殊技：小心风寒]</color>造成的失衡值提升5%；每引爆1个<color=#ffffff>[风眼]</color>，获得一层<color=#ffffff>[流势]</color>效果，至多获得3层；在<color=#ffffff>[强化特殊技：小心风寒]</color>期间进入<color=#ffffff>[自旋]</color>状态下换人时，洛克茜将消耗所有<color=#ffffff>[流势]</color>，每消耗1层可以维持<color=#ffffff>[自旋]</color>状态0.2秒，期间不消耗能量，至多维持0.6秒；<color=#ffffff>[强化特殊技：小心风寒]</color>命中敌人时，使敌人失衡易伤倍率提升30%，持续到目标从失衡状态恢复。
zh.4: 发动<color=#ffffff>[招架支援]</color>成功招架敌人攻击时，洛克茜回复1点能量，招式内至多回复1次；<color=#ffffff>[闪避反击：礼尚往来]</color>命中敌人时，回复2点能量，招式内至多回复1次；<color=#ffffff>[终结技：葬夜安魂曲]</color>造成的伤害提升20%，失衡值提升10%。
zh.6: 自身攻击造成的伤害无视目标15%<color=#A6C5FD>风属性伤害抗性</color>；<color=#ffffff>[特殊技：恕不远送]</color>引爆<color=#ffffff>[风眼]</color>生成巨型风旋时，主目标会被赋予<color=#ffffff>[余响]</color>效果，每间隔3秒在目标位置生成一次巨型风旋，共额外生成2次巨型风旋，重复触发时额外生成次数叠加且刷新<color=#ffffff>[余响]</color>的持续时间；巨型风旋造成的伤害倍率提升至原本的250%，造成的失衡提升20%。

en.1: When <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace</color> hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
en.2:
<color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color> deals 5% more Daze.
For each <color=#ffffff>Eye of the Storm</color> detonated, gain 1 stack of <color=#ffffff>Windflow</color>, up to 3 stacks.
During <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color>, if Roxy switches out after entering the <color=#ffffff>Whirlwind</color> state, she consumes all <color=#ffffff>Windflow</color>. Each stack consumed sustains the <color=#ffffff>Whirlwind</color> state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color> hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.
en.4: When a <color=#ffffff>Defensive Assist</color> successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When <color=#ffffff>Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy</color> hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. <color=#ffffff>Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial</color> deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.
en.6:
The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind RES</color>.
When <color=#ffffff>Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>Eyes of the Storm</color> to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with <color=#ffffff>Afterecho</color>. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of <color=#ffffff>Afterecho</color>. The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.

对前方大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得1点；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
